sandbox._comment3: enableWeakerNestedSandbox and enableWeakerNetworkIsolation are pinned false, and allowAllUnixSockets below with them: a repo's own .claude/settings.json can set all three, and this --settings file outranks project and local settings for a scalar. The list-valued siblings (network.allowUnixSockets, network.allowMachLookup) cannot be pinned this way -- arrays merge -- so compose-settings.py refuses to launch when a project sets those.

network._comment: allowLocalBinding false is pinned, not merely left out: a repo's own .claude/settings.json may set it, and on macOS true lets a subprocess connect() to localhost without the proxy that enforces deniedDomains ['*']. This --settings file outranks project and local settings.
